item.title: I don’t think ‘No Kings’ protestors can fix the mess at our borders
item.description: "We keep seeing the same "No Kings" rhetoric across the country: Do any of these demonstrators think they can do a better job cleaning up the mess of open borders and the fraud that's happened under "Biden's Reign?" We're all taxpayers, but why are we giving free handouts to illegals who haven't donated a friggin' dime to our system? Get a life." - A Silver Springs resident shares his opinion.
